title: Peer Support for Family Caregivers of Older Adults Living With Dementia
official: A Randomized Controlled Trial of Peer Support for Family Caregivers of Black Older Adults Living With Dementia (Pair 2 Care)
summary: Family caregivers of people living with dementia are at high risk of poor health when caregiving for their loved one. Peer Support for Family Caregivers of Older Adults Living with Dementia (Pair 2 Care©) is a simple, nonjudgmental, flexible, and potentially scalable peer support program developed with and for family caregivers along with former (previous) caregivers, community leaders, and healthcare providers. Using the experiences of trained former caregivers as mentors to current caregiver mentees, Pair 2 Care© may lower caregiver depressive symptoms and promote health and well-being of current caregivers, their loved ones, and former caregivers while informing future Alzheimer's disease and Alzheimer's disease-related dementia caregiving policy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* English-speaking
* Adult (18+)
* Family Caregivers of people living with dementia (current or former)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non-English-speaking
* Under age 18
* Non-family caregiver
